content:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Incident detected: elevated 5xx and increased p95 latency in eu-west-3 for Hosted API and multiple Dedicated pools. Alerts: API-5xx-eu-west-3, DP-queue-pressure. Auto-page sent to on-call.

irene-oncall: I'm on it. Observability shows a spike in control-plane auth errors to 503 from the cloud auth provider (token service) starting ~1799904300. Also, metrics ingest to our observability vendor is showing 429s. Could be cascading backpressure.

sam-platform: Confirmed. AWS eu-west-3 had an intermittent control plane networking issue around that window. We're seeing increased RTOs to STS endpoints. Dedicated pools are retrying auth and filling worker queues.

maria-sre: Impact: Hosted API error rate ~6% 5xx (mainly 502/503), p95 latency up from 120ms -> 1.2s. Dedicated pool queue length for eu-west-3-gpu1 increased ~3x. Customer-facing: some API calls time out or return 5xx. chris-support: noticed two enterprise customers reported degraded response times.

chris-support: Customers affected: AcmeCorp (elevated timeouts), DataSmith (rate-limited), small number of self-serve users. I'll open support tickets and add workarounds.

alice-se: Are we routing traffic to other regions? Any risk with model data residency?

sam-platform: Action plan: 1) Reduce auth traffic: enable token caching at gateway (60s), fall back to long-lived internal service tokens for Dedicated control plane. 2) Reroute new Hosted API traffic from eu-west-3 -> eu-west-1 for non-region-pinned customers. 3) Disable non-essential observability ingestion (debug spans) to lower write pressure. 4) Scale Dedicated pools in other regions to absorb traffic.

maria-sre: I'm going to temporarily disable instrumentation flushes to the vendor from the control plane in eu-west-3 to avoid 429s. Command:

```
kubectl -n controlplane set env deployment/obs-agent OBS_FLUSH=false --context eu-west-3
```

Do not remove core logs.

irene-oncall: Doing token caching at the edge now. Patch in edge gateway config:

```
edge.gateway.auth_cache_ttl_seconds = 60
```

Applying to eu-west-3 nodes.

ops-bot: Deploy started: edge-auth-cache v1.2 -> eu-west-3 (ci-run/8932) :construction: 

eng-runtime: We'll also add a temporary model fallback for Dedicated pools: route requests to quantized v2 when high-latency detected. Patch rolling.

sam-platform: Routing change: executing weighted policy to divert 35% of new request traffic from eu-west-3 -> eu-west-1 for non-pinned customers.

incident-bot: Update: reroute task submitted. Estimated completion 60s.

maria-sre: Reroute applied. Early telemetry shows 5xx down to ~2.1% and p95 improving to ~450ms. Dedicated queue length dropping.

chris-support: Notifying affected customers of mitigation and asking for any remaining impact. I'll keep a running list in the ticket.

alice-se: For enterprise customers with region pinning we'll notify CS for manual opt-in to failover.

irene-oncall: Handoff in 30m to sam-platform for follow-up and postmortem. Quick notes:
- Root cause: AWS regional networking + STS/auth provider retries causing control plane auth to fail (503s)
- Secondary cause: observability vendor 429s amplified retry/backpressure
- Mitigations: token cache, routing fallback, disable obs flush, scale other pools, fallback model
- Remaining work: longer-term token caching strategy, circuit-breaker on auth provider, offline metrics ingestion fallback

sam-platform: Taking over. Summary accepted. I'll coordinate with infra to request a soft SLA exception for affected customers and start a postmortem doc.

incident-bot: Pager cleared (ack by irene-oncall). Incident moving to "mitigated — monitoring".

maria-sre: Continuing to monitor. Setting alert thresholds stricter for control-plane auth 5xx in eu-west-3.

chris-support: Logged 3 customer tickets. Two customers confirmed recovery. One (DataSmith) wants rollback to previous region; CS is coordinating.

alice-se: FYI the dedicated pools that spilled over will bill as usual; finance notified for potential credits.

sam-platform: Next steps assigned:
- maria-sre: write technical postmortem (include timeline, metrics, logs)
- eng-runtime: implement auth circuit-breaker + backoff improvements
- platform: durable token caching & config change review
- support: customer comms and credits

irene-oncall: final note before handoff: thanks everyone for quick moves. Observability vendor says they experienced an ingestion cluster issue coincident with AWS networking, will follow up with their RCA.

sam-platform: Taking it from here. I'll post the postmortem link when ready and close the loop with customers.

incident-bot: Incident status: mitigated -> monitoring. last update 1799909500. :white_check_mark:
